title: Intrinsic realization preserves the fixed-coefficient open scalar mate
statement: For finite commutative rings A and B, a homomorphism phi:A -> B, an open immersion j:X -> Z, and any unbounded derived fixed-coefficient pro-etale A-module K, the intrinsic open scalar transpose at E_XA(K), followed by intrinsic extension by zero of realizationScalarIso_X, equals intrinsic scalar extension of openRealizationIso_A, followed by realizationScalarIso_Z, realization of the fixed-coefficient open scalar transpose at K, and the inverse openRealizationIso_B. All maps have precisely the normalization in FiniteCompactScalarCoordinates and FiniteCompactSupportScalarTransportData. This is a square solely of pro-etale realization functors; no etale site comparison occurs.

proof.text: Use the already proved forward_realization_mate identity for sfInverseRealizationRestriction. Its unit equation, inverted, proves the underived restriction cube: insert funInvIdAssoc, use naturality of the fixed open square and the realization restriction comparison, and cancel the adjacent equivalence units. This uses exactly the published definition of sfOpenRestriction.

Apply mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_comp_of_comm to localize the restriction cube. The localized open faces are definitionally openRealizationIso. Identify the derived realization adjunction with the exact localization of the original one by equality of counits. The existing mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_mate theorem then localizes the unit equation of the inverse-realization comparison; square_symm_hom identifies the localized inverse squares.

Use unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to show that the chosen realizationScalarIso is normalized by the localized forward restriction square. Apply equivalenceAdjunctionComparison_inverseMate to the localized restriction cube with these scalar comparison maps. Cancel the invertible open and scalar comparisons. The formula unit_mateEquiv_symm identifies each inverse mate component with the Hom-equivalence transpose in the statement.

theorem fixedOpenScalar_realization_transport
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) :
    ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ Z)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j A).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ X)).unit.app
              ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).functor.obj K)) ≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso (sfOpenRestriction j φ)).hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ X)).obj
              ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X A).functor.obj K))) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero j B).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((realizationScalarIso φ X).hom.app K) =
    (pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ Z)).map ((openRealizationIso A j).hom.app K) ≫
      (realizationScalarIso φ Z).hom.app ((ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z B).functor.map
        ((((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
      (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology Z) φ.ulift))).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriek
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) j).mapDerivedCategory.map
            (((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
      (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology X) φ.ulift))).unit.app K) ≫
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso (sfFixedOpenRestriction j φ)).hom.app
              ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtension (ProEt.topology X) φ.ulift).obj K))) ≫
      (openRealizationIso B j).inv.app
        ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtension (ProEt.topology X) φ.ulift).obj K)
